title: EliteTable: Self-Improving Program Search for Executable Control Policies
abstract_first: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by large language models (LLMs) that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits of existing solutions, and remixes of several solutions.
